name: Mary Coleman
role: Medora woman married at the Catholic church in 1885
bio: Mollie Coleman traveled to Andrews station and Sentinel Butte in summer 1884. In August 1885 Mary, eldest daughter of a Mr. and Mrs. Coleman, was married at the Catholic church in Medora by Father Martin.
mentions: Mollie Coleman has returned from Andrews station.
Mollie Coleman has gone to Sentinel Butte for a short stay.
